mapper.insert: insert into vehicles (id, user_id, make, model, year, license_plate, vin, created_at, updated_at) values( #{vehicle.id}, #{vehicle.userId}, #{vehicle.make}, #{vehicle.model}, #{vehicle.year}, #{vehicle.licensePlate}, #{vehicle.vin}, #{vehicle.createdAt}, #{vehicle.updatedAt} )
